sentences.en: Hello, everybody, and welcome back to the Psychology of Your 20s, the podcast where we talk through some of the big life changes and transitions of our 20s
sentences.zh: 大家好，欢迎回到《二十岁心理学》，在这个播客里，我们探讨二十多岁时会遇到的一些重大生活变动和过渡，

sentences.en: and what they mean for our psychology.
sentences.zh: 以及它们对我们心理意味着什么。

sentences.en: Hello, everybody.
sentences.zh: 大家好。

sentences.en: Welcome back to the show.
sentences.zh: 欢迎回到节目。

sentences.en: Welcome back to the podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 欢迎回到播客。

sentences.en: New listeners, old listeners, wherever you are in the world, it is great to have you here back for another episode.
sentences.zh: 无论你是新听众还是老听众，无论你身处世界何地，很高兴你能回来收听新的一期节目。

sentences.en: Today, I also want to formally welcome you to this week's little mini-series where I'm going to be focusing on how to create your dream life in your 20s.
sentences.zh: 今天，我也要正式欢迎大家来到本周的小型系列节目，我将专注于如何在你二十多岁时创造梦想生活。

sentences.en: So my kind of idea behind this segment, why I thought that it was important to talk about today, perhaps something that I hadn't spoken about before,
sentences.zh: 我做这个专题的想法，以及为什么我觉得今天讨论这个很重要，或许是我之前没有谈到过的内容，

sentences.en: is that there is so much evidence, advice, psychology, even my personal observations that don't always make it into one episode altogether.
sentences.zh: 是因为有太多的证据、建议、心理学理论，甚至是我个人的观察，无法全部塞进一期节目里。

sentences.en: I feel like I have a lot of different episodes for unique conundrums and unique experiences, but what I really wanted to do was combine that all into two episodes
sentences.zh: 我觉得我已经针对各种独特的难题和经历做了很多不同的节目，但我真正想做的是把它们整合到两期节目中，

sentences.en: where we look at all the different dimensions of our 20s that I think we experience, the greatest sense of worry and confusion, things like our careers, our finances,
sentences.zh: 我们来看看二十多岁时我们经历的各个维度，那些让我们感到最担忧和困惑的事情，比如职业、财务、

sentences.en: love, friendships, the future, and our personal growth, and really provide a bit of a blueprint or a guide for what is the best practice,
sentences.zh: 爱情、友谊、未来以及个人成长，并真正提供一份蓝图或指南，告诉大家什么是最佳实践，

sentences.en: what is the best thing to do during this decade around these different ideas and experiences that is not only going to allow us to really enjoy the freedom of this time,
sentences.zh: 在这个十年里，围绕这些不同的想法和经历，什么是最好的做法，这不仅能让我们真正享受这段时间的自由，

sentences.en: but also set us up for the future.
sentences.zh: 也能为我们的未来打下基础。

sentences.en: I think this decade is so incredibly romanticized and the stakes feel so high to kind of get everything right and to set ourselves up for success whilst also not really missing out
sentences.zh: 我觉得这个十年被过度浪漫化了，而且人们觉得把一切都做对、为成功做好准备的赌注太高了，同时又不想错过

sentences.en: on some of those crucial, fun, carefree times.
sentences.zh: 那些至关重要的、有趣的、无忧无虑的时光。

sentences.en: And I think we all deserved a bit of a holistic bird's eye view of exactly what kind of balance to strike and also some reassurance that you are not behind,
sentences.zh: 我认为我们都需要一个全面的鸟瞰视角，看看究竟该如何平衡，同时也需要一些安慰，让你知道你并没有落后，

sentences.en: there is no need to rush, there is still time, and also what the future may have in store.
sentences.zh: 没有必要匆忙，时间还来得及，也让我们看看未来可能会发生什么。

sentences.en: How to approach that daunting, sometimes overwhelming confusion with excitement rather than fear.
sentences.zh: 如何用兴奋而不是恐惧去面对那种令人生畏、有时甚至让人不知所措的困惑。

sentences.en: So this is part one of the Creating Your Dream Life mini-series where we are going to cover tips and theories around achieving fulfillment, direction, and growth in our careers
sentences.zh: 这是“创造你的梦想生活”系列的第一部分，我们将涵盖关于在职业生涯中实现成就感、方向感和成长的技巧与理论，

sentences.en: and in our financial lives.
sentences.zh: 以及我们的财务生活。

sentences.en: And part two, we're going to cover relationships, friendships, love, as well as our physical and our emotional, and crucially, our spiritual well-being.
sentences.zh: 在第二部分，我们将讨论人际关系、友谊、爱情，以及我们的身体、情感，还有至关重要的精神健康。

sentences.en: So this episode, I really want to get into and decode all of the kind of mysteries and confusions around making career and financial choices in your 20s that feel right
sentences.zh: 所以这一期，我真的想深入探讨并解读在二十多岁时做出职业和财务选择时所面临的各种谜团和困惑，这些选择要让你觉得正确，

sentences.en: and feel satisfying, but also allow us to really build this really wonderful future that we want without having the regret and the fear of the what-ifs.
sentences.zh: 觉得满足，同时也能让我们真正建立起我们想要的那个美好的未来，而不会因为“如果当初”而感到后悔和恐惧。

sentences.en: A question I get all the time in that I think in fact I ask myself a lot is how do I know that the decisions I'm making right now are not the same decisions
sentences.zh: 我经常被问到一个问题，事实上我自己也经常问自己，那就是我怎么知道我现在做的决定，

sentences.en: that I'm going to regret in five or ten years?
sentences.zh: 不是我五到十年后会后悔的决定呢？

sentences.en: Because this is our first decade of adulthood, we often don't have the hindsight to comprehend just how much our lives can and will change in the next five to ten years,
sentences.zh: 因为这是我们步入成年的第一个十年，我们往往没有足够的后见之明来理解在接下来的五到十年里，我们的生活会发生多大的变化，

sentences.en: and they may pan out in ways that we don't expect.
sentences.zh: 而且它们的发展方式可能会超出我们的预期。

sentences.en: So because we are all very new to this decade and new to this experience, we feel very boxed in by, I would say, a series of choices that have been socially imposed on us,
sentences.zh: 所以，因为我们对这十年和这种经历都很陌生，我们感到被一系列社会强加给我们的选择所束缚，

sentences.en: particularly three or four options in particular.
sentences.zh: 特别是其中三四个选项。

sentences.en: Do you work?
sentences.zh: 你是去工作吗？

sentences.en: Do you travel?
sentences.zh: 你是去旅行吗？

sentences.en: Do you pursue further education?
sentences.zh: 你是去深造吗？

sentences.en: Or do you settle down?
sentences.zh: 还是安定下来？

sentences.en: You know, I think that what comes from that is this series of what-if questions, this series of kind of pick me or make-a-choice situations.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我认为由此产生的是一系列“如果”的问题，一系列“选我”或“做决定”的情境。

sentences.en: So, do I go to uni and pursue professional success of being, you know, a lawyer, a doctor, an architect?
sentences.zh: 所以，我是去上大学，追求成为律师、医生、建筑师这样的职业成功吗？

sentences.en: Or do I go travelling?
sentences.zh: 还是去旅行？

sentences.en: Do I spend the next ten years climbing the corporate ladder?
sentences.zh: 我是花接下来的十年在职场攀爬吗？

sentences.en: Or do I pursue my passions and my pipe dreams?
sentences.zh: 还是去追求我的热情和白日梦？

sentences.en: Sometimes it feels like every choice we make closes more doors than it opens.
sentences.zh: 有时感觉我们做的每一个选择，关闭的门比打开的门更多。

sentences.en: If I'm this type of person, the type that is eager for financial independence and professional success, then I have to say goodbye to this other potential version of myself,
sentences.zh: 如果我是这种人，那种渴望经济独立和职业成功的人，那么我就必须告别另一个潜在的自己，

sentences.en: that really free-spirited traveller with endless time but also very little money.
sentences.zh: 那个真正自由奔放、拥有无限时间但几乎没有钱的旅行者。

sentences.en: And I wish that I could be every possible version of myself.
sentences.zh: 我真希望我能成为每一个可能的自己。

sentences.en: I wish that I didn't have to choose.
sentences.zh: 我真希望我不必做出选择。

sentences.en: It's something that I hear constantly.
sentences.zh: 这是我经常听到的话。

sentences.en: And I guess the question that comes from that is, why can't we kind of have it all?
sentences.zh: 我想由此产生的问题是，为什么我们不能拥有一切呢？

sentences.en: Why can't we be it all?
sentences.zh: 为什么我们不能成为一切呢？

sentences.en: I think a big misconception we face during this decade is that the choices we are making now will be our final answer.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们在这一十年面临的一个巨大误区是，我们现在做的选择将是我们的最终答案。

sentences.en: Part of that is this major contradiction inherent in our 20s that can make things so confusing but also wonderful.
sentences.zh: 部分原因是二十多岁时固有的这种重大矛盾，它让事情变得如此困惑，但也如此美妙。

sentences.en: You know, in one year we are told that this is the decade of opportunity where we are kind of given a few years of free passes to really take our time and explore
sentences.zh: 你知道，一年里有人告诉我们这是充满机遇的十年，我们有几年的“免费通行证”来慢慢探索，

sentences.en: and then in the other year is this little voice telling us that we are falling behind, that we should have figured it out by now, that this is where
sentences.zh: 而另一年里，又有小声音告诉我们正在落后，我们现在应该已经想清楚了，这是我们

sentences.en: our life foundation is established.
sentences.zh: 生活基础建立的时候。

sentences.en: I talk about this concept quite a bit on the show but I think our 20s are a continuous example of what we call the paradox of choice.
sentences.zh: 我在节目中经常谈论这个概念，但我认为我们的二十多岁是所谓的“选择悖论”的持续例证。

sentences.en: So the paradox of choice is this theory that suggests when we have an abundance of options, actually what that requires is more effort and when we have more options,
sentences.zh: 所以选择悖论是一个理论，它认为当我们有大量选择时，实际上需要付出更多的努力，而当我们有更多选择时，

sentences.en: we feel less satisfied with our choices compared to when we have fewer and when we think about the landscape of our 20s, something that we are is very much spoiled for choice
sentences.zh: 相比选择较少时，我们对自己的选择感到更不满意。当我们想到二十多岁的环境时，我们确实是“选择太多”，

sentences.en: and we might think that that is more liberating, we might think that that gives us more freedom but what a lot of these psychologists are saying is really that choice
sentences.zh: 我们可能认为这更解放，认为这给了我们更多的自由，但许多心理学家所说的是，这种选择

sentences.en: actually paralyzes us because we don't know how to weigh up all of the pros and cons, the costs and benefits of these decisions.
sentences.zh: 实际上让我们瘫痪了，因为我们不知道如何权衡这些决定的所有利弊、成本和收益。

sentences.en: So we are a generation facing the curse of too much choice and maybe that is what's contributing to heightened levels of anxiety around not making the most of our formative years
sentences.zh: 所以我们这一代人正面临着“选择过多”的诅咒，也许这正是导致我们对未能充分利用成长岁月感到焦虑加剧的原因，

sentences.en: or worse yet, I think there's fear of making a choice and it being the wrong one.
sentences.zh: 或者更糟糕的是，我认为还有一种害怕做出错误选择的恐惧。

sentences.en: Something we really need to acknowledge before we start this episode is that this decade is not always going to be glamorous and romantic.
sentences.zh: 在开始这一期节目之前，我们需要真正承认的一点是，这十年并不总是光鲜亮丽和浪漫的。

sentences.en: I think we constantly think that we should be further along, that we should have this career of our dreams or even an idea of what that dream should be by a certain age
sentences.zh: 我认为我们总是认为自己应该走得更远，应该拥有梦想中的职业，或者至少在某个年龄就应该知道那个梦想是什么，

sentences.en: but when you talk to more and more people about this, you kind of realise that everyone is just as confused as the next and we learn a lot of what we think our lives should be like
sentences.zh: 但当你和越来越多的人谈论这件事时，你会发现每个人都和别人一样困惑。我们认为生活应该是什么样子的，很多是从

sentences.en: from very unrealistic,
sentences.zh: 非常不现实的、

sentences.en: I would say, narrow hues, from very highly idealised depictions of what this decade should be, from movies, from cinema and unfortunately a lot of them are false.
sentences.zh: 狭隘的视角，从对这十年应该是什么样子的过度理想化描述中学习到的，比如电影、影院，不幸的是，其中很多都是假的。

sentences.en: So there's two things that I've come to realise.
sentences.zh: 所以我意识到两件事。

sentences.en: Number one, we need to throw out any kind of thinking or prediction of what you think your life should look like.
sentences.zh: 第一，我们需要抛弃任何关于你认为生活应该是什么样子的想法或预测。

sentences.en: The vision you have for your future right now is going to change a million times and where you think you'll end up is probably not going to be where you actually end up.
sentences.zh: 你现在对未来的愿景会改变一百万次，你认为自己最终会去的地方，很可能不是你真正最终到达的地方。

sentences.en: I would say the chances are highly unlikely.
sentences.zh: 我想说可能性非常小。

sentences.en: You know, I finished high school thinking I was going to work in politics.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我高中毕业时以为我会从事政治工作。

sentences.en: Then I graduated uni and I was a management consultant and now, three years later, you know, I make a psychology podcast full time.
sentences.zh: 然后我大学毕业，做了管理顾问，现在三年过去了，你知道，我全职做心理学播客。

sentences.en: That wasn't what I had in mind.
sentences.zh: 那不是我当初想的。

sentences.en: That was a completely different idea to what I had even 12 months ago.
sentences.zh: 那和我12个月前的想法完全不同。

sentences.en: But I think it's even better because I let life surprise me and I didn't tie myself down to a particular idea of who I needed to be.
sentences.zh: 但我认为这甚至更好，因为我让生活给我惊喜，我没有把自己束缚在“我需要成为什么样的人”的特定想法中。

sentences.en: I let myself change.
sentences.zh: 我让自己改变。

sentences.en: I let myself make mistakes because I think that's firmly what I think this decade is for.
sentences.zh: 我让自己犯错，因为我认为这正是这十年的意义所在。

sentences.en: That is my underlying philosophy throughout this whole idea of creating your dream life.
sentences.zh: 这就是我贯穿整个“创造梦想生活”理念的底层哲学。

sentences.en: Allow yourself to make mistakes.
sentences.zh: 允许自己犯错。

sentences.en: Allow yourself to accept change.
sentences.zh: 允许自己接受改变。

sentences.en: I think secondly, no decision or experience is ever a waste of your time and you also have the agency to change your reality at any point.
sentences.zh: 我认为第二点是，没有任何决定或经历是浪费时间，而且你随时都有能力改变你的现实。

sentences.en: It's really never too late to make a life-altering decision.
sentences.zh: 做出改变人生的决定永远都不晚。

sentences.en: You can be 50 and decide to go back to school.
sentences.zh: 你可以50岁时决定重返校园。

sentences.en: You can be 35 and quit your job.
sentences.zh: 你可以35岁时辞掉工作。

sentences.en: You can be 80 before you really find your passion.
sentences.zh: 你可以在80岁之前才真正找到你的热情。

sentences.en: You start your first book.
sentences.zh: 你开始写你的第一本书。

sentences.en: You meet the love of your life.
sentences.zh: 你遇到了你的一生挚爱。

sentences.en: You're not a passive actor or a sidekick in your own life.
sentences.zh: 你不是自己生活中的被动演员或配角。

sentences.en: That's something we really need to remember.
sentences.zh: 这是我们需要真正记住的一点。

sentences.en: You are the main character.
sentences.zh: 你是主角。

sentences.en: So what's kind of stopping you from trying on different versions of yourself and seeing which one fits?
sentences.zh: 那么，是什么阻止你去尝试不同版本的自己，看看哪一个最适合你呢？

sentences.en: What's stopping you from deciding that one day the corporate life isn't for you.
sentences.zh: 是什么阻止你决定有一天职场生活不适合你？

sentences.en: You're quitting your job or maybe you're doing the reverse.
sentences.zh: 你辞掉工作，或者也许你反其道而行之。

sentences.en: You can give a million reasons why you cannot do that but I think when your happiness is the number one priority especially during this decade where I think we're allowed
sentences.zh: 你可以列举一百万个理由说明你不能那样做，但我认为当幸福是第一优先级时，特别是在这十年里，我认为我们被允许

sentences.en: to be a lot more selfish than other decades when you're kind of on this journey of creating your dream life happiness is really the core factor in your decision making.
sentences.zh: 比其他十年更自私一些。当你踏上创造梦想生活的旅程时，幸福确实是你决策的核心因素。

sentences.en: So in this episode part one of this episode we are going to break down my ten key tips to getting the most out of your career your finances and your time in your 20s
sentences.zh: 所以在这期节目中，也就是本系列的第一部分，我们将分解我的十个关键建议，帮助你在二十多岁时充分利用你的职业、财务和时间，

sentences.en: to create your dream life set yourself up for success but also really enjoy this sacred period of your life.
sentences.zh: 去创造你的梦想生活，为成功做好准备，同时也真正享受这段神圣的时光。

sentences.en: So without further ado let's get into it.
sentences.zh: 那么，废话不多说，让我们开始吧。

sentences.en: The big dilemma I think that we need to overcome first and foremost when we're working towards this idea of creating our dream life is actually understanding what that looks like.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们在努力实现创造梦想生活这一理念时，首先需要克服的巨大困境，实际上是理解那是什么样子。

sentences.en: Now that's a highly individual question depending on factors like our values family expectations culture even the books and movies that we've been exposed to that conceptualization
sentences.zh: 这是一个高度个性化的问题，取决于我们的价值观、家庭期望、文化，甚至是我们接触过的书籍和电影等因素，这种概念化

sentences.en: is going to look really different for everyone you know for some people our 20s are about complete freedom and minimal responsibility and for others they're focused
sentences.zh: 对每个人来说看起来都非常不同。你知道，对有些人来说，二十多岁意味着完全的自由和最小的责任，而对另一些人来说，他们专注于

sentences.en: on settling down or pursuing love or your soulmate in fact I really think that on this whole planet you could never find two people who are perfectly aligned on what they want
